lines.text: Always thirsty? Always tired? Running to the bathroom again and again? Raju has all three.
lines.tts: Always thirsty? Always tired? Running to the bathroom, again and again? Raju has all three.

lines.text: These can be warning signs of diabetes.
lines.tts: These can be warning signs... of diabetes.

lines.text: When we eat, the body breaks food down into glucose, the sugar in our blood. It is fuel for muscles, the brain and every organ.
lines.tts: When we eat, the body breaks food down into glucose, the sugar in our blood. It is fuel for muscles, the brain, and every organ.

lines.text: To get inside the cells, glucose needs insulin, a hormone made by the pancreas.
lines.tts: To get inside the cells, glucose needs insulin... a hormone made by the pancreas.

lines.text: In Type 1 diabetes, the immune system destroys the cells that make insulin.
lines.tts: In type one diabetes, the immune system destroys the cells that make insulin.

lines.text: In Type 2, insulin is there, but the cells stop responding to it.
lines.tts: In type two, insulin is there... but the cells stop responding to it.

lines.text: And in pregnancy, hormones can cause gestational diabetes.
lines.tts: And in pregnancy, hormones can cause gestational diabetes.

lines.text: The signs: thirst, frequent urination, hunger, tiredness, blurred vision, and wounds that heal slowly. But many people with Type 2 notice nothing for years.
lines.tts: The signs: thirst, frequent urination, hunger, tiredness, blurred vision, and wounds that heal slowly. But many people with type two, notice nothing for years.

lines.text: Family history, age, inactivity and excess weight raise the risk. It is not simply caused by eating sweets.
lines.tts: Family history, age, inactivity, and excess weight, raise the risk. It is not simply caused by eating sweets.

lines.text: Left high for years, blood sugar damages the heart, kidneys, eyes and nerves.
lines.tts: Left high for years, blood sugar damages the heart, kidneys, eyes, and nerves.

lines.text: Doctors confirm it with blood tests: fasting glucose 126 or above, 200 or above two hours after a glucose drink, or HbA1c 6.5 percent or above. Don't diagnose yourself from one home reading.
lines.tts: Doctors confirm it with blood tests: fasting glucose, one twenty-six or above. Two hundred or above, two hours after a glucose drink. Or H-b-A-one-c, six point five percent or above. Don't diagnose yourself from one home reading.

lines.text: The good news: diabetes can be managed. Eat balanced meals, stay active, check your sugar as advised, and never stop your medicines on your own.
lines.tts: The good news: diabetes can be managed. Eat balanced meals, stay active, check your sugar as advised, and never stop your medicines on your own.

lines.text: Type 1 can't be prevented by lifestyle. But the risk of Type 2 can often be reduced.
lines.tts: Type one can't be prevented by lifestyle. But the risk of type two, can often be reduced.

lines.text: Know diabetes. Control diabetes. Live a healthier life.
lines.tts: Know diabetes. Control diabetes. Live a healthier life.
